dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: May everyone enjoy good health, booming businesses, rewarding careers, wealth, and success!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Truly refined! May wealth find you, too!

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: Judging by your appearance... You must be a noble! Maybe one who's achieved extreme wealth a long time ago!

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: If you ever decide to expand in Yilong Wharf, you can count on me to help with anything you may need!

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: I'm Baishu, the owner of Jiulue Teahouse.

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: Many of the nearby inns are under my name as well. Rest assured, you can leave your food and accommodation in Yilong Wharf to my staff.

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: Your presence is unfathomable! I look forward to meeting you again!

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: You're too kind! I was merely lucky to ride the wave of industrial upgrading.

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: Once upon a time, I was a very ordinary tea farmer who grew mediocre tea.

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: It's all thanks to the inspiration I received from Master Jiuguan that my fortunes took a drastic change for the better!

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: When the primary tea-making equipment in Chenyu Vale was being upgraded from classic tea cauldrons to machinery, I caught wind and took advantage of that early adoption to accumulate a substantial amount of funds.

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: I started a teahouse with those funds and soon expanded to inns and restaurants.

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: After visiting my teahouses, restaurants, and inns, foreign guests often purchase some tea leaves to try back at home or as a gift.

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: I failed to be an outstanding tea farmer, but I fully intend to provide financial support and publicity to my former colleagues...

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: I'm quite satisfied with where my career's gone now, so my next goal is to help more business people, just like Master Jiuguan!
